Hello! My name is Vaishnav Sudarshan, a high schooler (class of 2029) at Basis Independent Bellevue (Washington State, USA). 

The question of who I *am* (not specifically me, obviously) has been debated by philosophers for millenia and they still haven't come to a consensus, so I'll talk *about* me instead. 

My main interests are in math, computer science, and linguistics, which may combine with related fields like AI, biology, or physics. This is reflected in the subject matter of my blog posts. However, I occasionally might go off-topic if something random is really interesting. 

As for languages, I speak English and Tamil natively. I'm studying French in school, and I have also dabbled / am dabbling in many other languages that are more for analyzing them linguistically to notice cool observations than actually aiming for proficiency, such as Hindi, Telugu, Chinese, Portuguese, Indonesian, and German. 

I guess I speak proficient Python and Java as well if that counts??? I do know the basics of a few other programming languages too though (JavaScript, C++, Asymptote, Rust, and Lua for example), just not with as much experience.
